sessions.note: Briefed re-run from the clean session-5 canvas; the unbriefed attempt is kept as a control at workspace/scratch/duo3_sessions/duo3.s6-unbriefed.*. Front cut from the skull (travel 3 -> 10 cells, corr 0.91 with PROMINENCE) and given a dark charred lip; orbit rebuilt as a hole with a bone rim, which removed the piece's only white cell; intact eye built to pair with it; left rim varied by thickness. THE DISSOLUTION DECISION the brief asked for: it became a MARGIN, not by choosing an area but because reach() is measured from the front and came in with it -- 40% of the bounding box down to a 5-12 cell band. The wash that remained was duo3_bg's, not the dissolve's, and that pass now measures margin from the burning edge.
